about: Modwerk source-only quick-mod-assign package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/quick-mod-assign.

mods.title: Quick Mod Assign
mods.summary: Hold FIX or SAMPLER and turn a knob to link that parameter to velocity or aftertouch.
mods.description: Hold FIX and turn a knob on a sound page to link that parameter to velocity, or hold SAMPLER for aftertouch. It fills the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch mod slots, and while the key is held each linked knob shows its amount as a performance lock does.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: The author's combined image RC18 (core-ar2 0.7, this module's build QM10 and twelve other modules) ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported: links, display, kit save, reload and power cycle passed. This package has not run on a unit.
